subject: Grand Theft Auto VI on PC
title: Is GTA 6 coming to PC? Not at launch, and there is no date yet
answer: Not yet. Grand Theft Auto VI launches Nov. 19, 2026, only on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar Games has not announced a PC version, a PC release date or PC system requirements. Based on Rockstar's history, most gaming outlets expect a PC port months after the console launch, but that is a guess, not an announcement.
body:
Rockstar's recent big games have all reached PC well after consoles. GTA IV arrived on PC about eight months after consoles (April to December 2008). GTA V came out on consoles in September 2013 and on PC in April 2015, about 19 months later. Red Dead Redemption 2 followed the same pattern: October 2018 on consoles, November 2019 on PC. That is why estimates for a GTA 6 PC version range from late 2027 to 2028. There is also no PS4 or Xbox One version.

On consoles, GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on Nov. 19, 2026, rolling out time zone by time zone, and digital pre-orders can already pre-load the game. The base price in North America is $79.99. Reports put the PS5 download at about 212 GB, so plan for storage space, and Push Square reports that physical editions contain a download code rather than a game disc.

GTA Online for GTA 6 is a separate question. Sony's PlayStation FAQ describes GTA 6 as "a single-player experience," and Rockstar has not given a date for an online mode. Many outlets read that to mean online play will not be part of the Nov. 19 launch, but Rockstar has not formally confirmed when, or in what form, online will arrive.
in_the_news: GTA 6 launches on Nov. 19, 2026, and pre-loading opened the week before, prompting a wave of searches from PC players asking when their version is coming.

faq.q: When is GTA 6 coming out on PC?
faq.a: There is no date. Rockstar has announced only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S for Nov. 19, 2026.
No PC storefront listing exists yet, on Steam, the Epic Games Store or the Rockstar Games Launcher.

faq.q: When will GTA 6 Online come out?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. Sony's FAQ calls GTA 6 a single-player experience, so online play is not expected on launch day.
At midnight local time on Nov. 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

faq.q: Is GTA 6 on PS4 or Xbox One?
faq.a: No. It is only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
$79.99 for the standard edition in North America; the Ultimate Edition costs more and adds cosmetic and vehicle extras.
